zara (events): quick thought — tiny after-work: 'Scooters & Sushi Stroll' Fri? idea: meet at 6:15, scooter over to two nearby sushi spots, then a park hang. low-key, bring cash or card. prefer inside seating or outdoor picnic mats? vote below. :scooter: :sushi: :sparkles:

tom: love it. 6:15 works. prefer inside seating at the first spot (windy night last time).

han: im in but might be late (traffic). prefer outdoor picnic at the end though if weather's nice. veg sushi ok here.

priya: count me in! can only do 6:45 earliest. can we keep it small-ish (8 people)? allergic to avocado FYI. :avocado:

zara (events): noted on avocados & size. i'll make a 12hr poll to pick seating + start time. if inside wins i'll try to reserve a 6:15 table for 6-8; if picnic wins i'll bring mats and bug spray. will post final plan tomorrow AM.

ops-bot: Poll: "Scooters & Sushi Stroll - pick start time + end hang style"	6:15 + inside seating	2 votes	6:45 + picnic mats	1 vote (ends in 12h)

tom: if picnic wins ill bring a couple small blankets and a thermos of hot tea.

han: i can grab a backup pair of scooter locks in case someone needs one.

priya: if we lock 6:45 i'm still in, otherwise i might have to skip the first stop.

zara (events): nice — poll ends tonight. if you haven't voted, react to ops-bot poll or reply here. final: i'll DM folks about scooter meetup point and allergy notes. tiny rule: please avoid bringing avocado-heavy rolls (priya's allergic). see y'all for a breezy stroll! :sparkles:
